items.label: Working capital & permits
items.source: Assumption: CUP/engineering, permits, 2-3 months operating cash
items.note: Not depreciated.

items.label: Share of capital borrowed
items.source: Assumption (80% debt, 20% owner or member equity)
items.note: Lender terms are a placeholder.

items.label: Interest rate
items.note: Farm Credit / VSBFA terms not yet quoted.

items.label: Depreciation life (straight-line)
items.note: Tax item only; excluded from cash.

items.label: Owner pay target
items.note: Used for break-even with owner pay.

items.label: Share of head: Full service (staff kill + cut, company Custom Permit)
items.source: Assumption; Option B is the chosen model
items.note: The three shares must sum to 1. A tier is a legal configuration: any staff hands-on work makes that job custom-exempt with the company as operator, i.e. Full service.

items.label: Share of head: Coached (owner does the work, company advises only)
items.source: Assumption; Option E advise-only line is unconfirmed by VDACS
items.note: Staff hands-on work on a coached job flips it to Full service legally.

items.label: Share of head: Rent (unit + cooler storage, owner does the work)
items.source: Assumption; Option D, personal-use exemption 9 CFR 303.1(a)(1) or owner's own Custom Permit
items.note: Whether storing personal-use carcasses needs a Meat Handlers Permit or warehouseman registration is open (round 4).

items.label: Unit rental fee per head
items.source: Option D example $400/rental day, assuming 1 rental day per head; no red-meat rental rate found
items.note: Poultry MPU rates ($25-150/day) are subsidized and show structure, not price.

items.label: Cooler storage fee (Coached and Rent tiers)
items.source: Rate from T&E Meats $25/head/week dry-aging past 2 weeks (2025); Blue Ridge Meats $10/day per cart after 72 h (2026). Applied here to the base window [inferred]: incumbents give a free window (Gore's 3 weeks, Blue Ridge 72 h)
items.note: Full service storage and aging stay inside the Full-tier price and extras.

items.label: Cooler storage weeks per head (Coached and Rent tiers)
items.note: Longer dry-aging is an add-on at the same weekly rate.

items.label: Coaching fee per head (Coached tier)
items.source: Option E planning rate $125/hr [placeholder] (below MPA's ~$150/hr implied value, 2025 [inferred]) x 3 hours per head
items.note: Instruction and advice only.

items.label: Staff hours per head, Full service
items.source: NMPAN/Lorentz 2010: about 8 man-hours to cut a custom beef + about 1 hour to kill
items.note: Used only for the labor check; payroll follows employee hours by year.

items.label: Company hauls offal on Coached jobs (1 = yes, 0 = no)
items.note: Packaging cost applies to Full service only; rendering to Full, and to Coached when this is 1. Rent: offal stays on the renter's farm.
